title: Tenure Points on a Restarted Multi-Policy Discount — RentGuard Renters Policy
content:
Training note: restart tenure points on the RentGuard Renters Policy.

**The rule.** When the whole months from the renters original effective date to today are 48 or more, 2 points are added to the discount percentages after the restart of the multi-policy discount; when they are 24 or more but fewer than 48, 1 point is added; when they are fewer than 24, no tenure points are added.

**From which date is tenure counted?**
From the renters original effective date, the first inception date on the renters policy record, to today — not from the start of the current term.

**How are months counted?**
In whole months; a part month is not counted.

**Where do the bands meet?**
- 48 whole months: 2 points. 47 whole months: 1 point.
- 24 whole months: 1 point. 23 whole months: no points.

| Whole months since the renters original effective date | Points added |
|---|---|
| 48 or more | 2 |
| 24 to 47 | 1 |
| fewer than 24 | 0 |

**Hypothetical example.** A renter whose original effective date is 10 January four years before today's date of 10 January has 48 whole months and adds 2 points; had today been 9 January, the count would be 47 whole months and 1 point.
